decisions.reason: Using Fun Fact images to fill article-ending white space does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or where they are placed.
The filler-image decision does not change the article body typography state; the separate Garamond statement is consistent with the candidate's existing font value.
Adding Fun Fact filler images does not alter category-label display, placement, allowed categories, or article mappings.
The source decision concerns Fun Fact images for white-space correction, not advertisement rendering quality; the attached backup ads are a separate clause and do not change the clarity requirement.
The optional use of Fun Fact filler images does not necessarily modify the established polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The new filler-asset type remains subject to the existing conditional image-quality rule and does not change that rule's current state.
Creating supplemental Fun Fact images does not change the required source of article content.
The filler-image decision does not change author-name, author-photo, identity-matching, source, or placement requirements.
Fun Fact images for affected article endings do not change inclusion or placement of the supplied tribute page.
The source decision concerns article-ending filler assets and does not modify author-photo shape or size.
The assembly requirement already includes images among its content inputs, so the proposed Fun Fact images require no change to its state.
Using Fun Fact images to address article-ending white space does not change the requirement to create the magazine layout template.
